stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Vertigo and the other Mutates take Xavier and Magneto for their master, and Brainchild has the captives chained in Sinister's citadel. Both fight on for Sinister until Cyclops blasts him apart and Brainchild rushes to save him.
stages.whoA: Vertigo, a fellow Mutate who serves Sinister
stages.whoB: Brainchild, the Mutate who keeps Sinister's devices

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Ruckus leads the Nasty Boys and the Mutates, Amphibius among them, in an ambush on the powerless X-Men in the Savage Land. They fight side by side for Sinister until the X-Men get their powers back.
stages.whoA: Ruckus, the Nasty Boy who leads the joint ambush
stages.whoB: Amphibius, a Mutate in his ambush on the X-Men

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Amphibius and the Mutates catch Xavier and Magneto sneaking into the citadel, and Brainchild orders the pair chained to the wall. Both serve Sinister until the X-Men break free and bring him down.
stages.whoA: Brainchild, the Mutate who keeps the citadel
stages.whoB: Amphibius, a Mutate who brings him captives

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Amphibius defies his old master Magneto, and Vertigo overwhelms Magneto and Xavier so the Mutates can take them to their new master. Later both fight the powerless X-Men, and Sinister boosts Vertigo with Magneto's strength.
stages.whoA: Vertigo, a fellow Mutate whose power fells his captives
stages.whoB: Amphibius, a fellow Mutate in the Savage Land

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Hairbag and Ruckus help the Nasty Boys spring Sinister's trap on Scott and Jean. In the Savage Land, Ruckus leads them against the powerless X-Men until the X-Men win back their powers.
stages.whoA: Ruckus, the loudmouth who leads the Nasty Boys
stages.whoB: Hairbag, a brawler in his Nasty Boys

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Hairbag and Ruckus help the Nasty Boys snatch Jean as she leaves her wedding, then carry her off through a portal. They later turn up with Sinister at the Axis of Time and retreat with him.
stages.whoA: Ruckus, a fellow Nasty Boy on the wedding raid
stages.whoB: Hairbag, a fellow Nasty Boy on the wedding raid

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Vertigo now runs with the Nasty Boys, and she and Hairbag help snatch Jean after her wedding, then slip away through a portal. Both later stand with Sinister at the Axis of Time.
stages.whoA: Vertigo, the newest member of the Nasty Boys
stages.whoB: Hairbag, a fellow Nasty Boy

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: George and Ruckus spring Sinister's trap on Scott and Jean, and Ruckus floors Wolverine with a scream as the Nasty Boys carry Jean off. In the Savage Land, both beat the powerless X-Men, and George grabs Rogue.
stages.whoA: Ruckus, the loudmouth leading the Nasty Boys
stages.whoB: George, the gooey Nasty Boy at his side

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: George's Nasty Boys and Vertigo's Mutates overwhelm the powerless X-Men and lock them up in Sinister's citadel. When Wolverine and Ka-Zar storm the cells, George and Vertigo try to keep the prisoners in.
stages.whoA: Vertigo, a Mutate who guards the captives with him
stages.whoB: George, a Nasty Boy who guards the captives with her

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: George and Hairbag help the Nasty Boys trap Jean for Sinister, then join the Savage Land ambush on the powerless X-Men. Both fight on until the X-Men win back their powers and the Nasty Boys flee.
stages.whoA: Hairbag, a fellow brawler in the Nasty Boys
stages.whoB: George, a stretchy fellow Nasty Boy

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Zaladane, Garokk's High Priestess, steers Sauron into bringing Storm to the Savage Land. At Garokk's command she frees Storm's power to feed him, then tells Sauron he has outlived his use.
stages.whoA: Zaladane, the High Priestess who serves him
stages.whoB: Garokk, the stone god she serves

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Gog and Spiral chase Longshot to Earth for Mojo, but Wolverine helps drive their band off. When Mojo comes himself, both serve his televised hunt, and Mojo yells for them to save him from Longshot.
stages.whoA: Spiral, who leads the hunt for Longshot
stages.whoB: Gog, a hunter in her band

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Gladiator leads the Imperial Guard, Oracle among them, in Lilandra's duel with the X-Men on the Moon over Jean's fate. The Guard beats the X-Men down until the Phoenix flares up again and turns on Gladiator.
stages.whoA: Oracle, a psychic in the Imperial Guard he leads
stages.whoB: Gladiator, leader of the Imperial Guard

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Gladiator leads the Imperial Guard into Lilandra's duel with the X-Men on the Moon, and the twin robot Warstar fights in his ranks. Warstar boasts that organics are too slow to beat it.
stages.whoA: Warstar, a twin robot in the Guard he leads
stages.whoB: Gladiator, leader of the Imperial Guard

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Navigator serves aboard Raknar's ship and tracks the Starjammers for him, and he leaves the captive Cyclops in her care. She then shows Cyclops a faked log that proves Raknar plans to murder Jandra.
stages.whoA: Raknar, the corrupt commander she serves, then exposes
stages.whoB: Navigator, his officer who exposes his plot

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Raknar chases Jandra to Earth, claiming Corsair abducted the witness, while he secretly works to silence her for the Lord Chamberlain. The X-Men expose his plan and he goes back to face Shi'ar justice.
stages.whoA: Raknar, the Shi'ar commander sent to silence her
stages.whoB: Jandra, the witness he is paid to silence

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Raknar hunts the Starjammers, Ch'od among them, to Earth to get at the witness Jandra. Ch'od breaks radio silence with a coded call to Corsair that baits Raknar into a trap, then opens fire on him.
stages.whoA: Raknar, the corrupt commander he baits and fires on
stages.whoB: Ch'od, the Starjammer who springs the trap on him

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Ch'od and Raza crew Corsair's Starjammer and hide the witness Jandra on Earth from Raknar's patrol. Raza helps guard Jandra and a captive Storm, and Ch'od springs the trap on Raknar's ship.
stages.whoA: Raza, a swordsman in his Starjammers crew
stages.whoB: Ch'od, a fellow Starjammer

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Ch'od and Hepzibah crew Corsair's Starjammer and hide the witness Jandra on Earth from Raknar's patrol. Hepzibah takes on Storm, and Ch'od springs the trap on Raknar's ship.
stages.whoA: Hepzibah, a catlike crewmate on the Starjammer
stages.whoB: Ch'od, a fellow Starjammer

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Hepzibah hides Jandra from Raknar's patrol and ambushes Storm, believing the X-Men have sold the Starjammers out. Jandra welcomes her back and asks why the lady is tied up.
stages.whoA: Jandra, the young witness she protects
stages.whoB: Hepzibah, a Starjammer who guards her

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Hepzibah and Raza ambush Storm together, warning her to keep the weather calm, and hold her in the hideout where they guard Jandra. They believe Cyclops has sold them out to Raknar, until Navigator shows him the truth.
stages.whoA: Raza, a fellow Starjammer who ambushes Storm with her
stages.whoB: Hepzibah, a fellow Starjammer who ambushes Storm with him

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Raza guards Jandra in the Starjammers' hideout and helps Hepzibah take Storm captive. Jandra is glad to see them back and asks why the lady is tied up.
stages.whoA: Raza, a Starjammer who guards her
stages.whoB: Jandra, the young witness he guards
